key_insight: Soft-MoQE learns input-dependent combinations of fixed quantum feature maps, avoiding quantum-parameter optimization while outperforming individual experts and simple baselines.
engineering_relevance: Moving trainable routing to a classical network reduces quantum training cost by orders of magnitude, offering a practical design direction for resource-constrained hybrid QML.
method: Encode inputs with a heterogeneous pool of non-trainable quantum circuits.
Train a classical gating network to weight quantum embeddings for each input.
Combine expert embeddings using class-dependent, learned soft routing.
evidence_signal: On PCA-reduced MNIST parity, MNIST 10-class, and FashionMNIST, Soft-MoQE beats the best single expert, uniform expert averaging, and a linear baseline, with task-dependent performance comparable to a trainable quantum neural network.
watch_item: Evaluation is limited to three PCA-reduced tasks; robustness to hardware noise and scaling to higher-dimensional inputs remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: Soft Mixture of Quantum Experts for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Learning
